agentPrompts.label: Show me total AUM and unrealized P/L
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-office` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize total consolidated AUM in the base currency, unrealized P/L, entity count, and the headline allocation. This app only reads Busabase and never trades, moves money, or rebalances.

agentPrompts.label: Where are we concentrated?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-office` skill in this folder, then check for asset-class, institution, or entity concentration and any allocation drift from the target allocation, and report them as neutral facts, never as trading advice.

agentPrompts.label: Show performance by entity
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-office` skill in this folder, then show me cost basis versus market value and unrealized P/L (absolute and percent) for each entity and for the whole family office in the base currency.
